_comment: 26.1.0 is the first final release and the first macOS build since 26.1.0-rc.2 (early July) -- Mac users were three months of work behind with no in-app download path, because no macos platform block had ever been published. release_url/notes_url deliberately point at the PUBLIC notes page on this host, not at the GitHub release: the app repo is private, so a release URL 404s for every tester. macOS is Developer-ID signed + Apple-notarized + stapled; Windows is self-signed (real Authenticode + DigiCert timestamp) so SmartScreen still warns.
